device_rationale: Single-worker random-input timing pilots favored MPS: roughly 4.7–5.7 times one CPU thread for inference and 2.0–2.9 times for training, measured while three CPU training workers were active. These are not isolated or full-run aggregate throughput measurements. Sampling batch size 256 is retained because larger pilot batches did not improve per-draw time.
optimizer_and_architecture: Exact recovered larger architecture and Adam/diffusion settings; a common 600-epoch, 9,600-update budget with learning-rate drops at epochs 450 and 540. Device choice does not use model-quality scores.
candidate_validation: Four original-grid, 64-draw CRPS checks on all 256 validation trajectories at epochs 150, 300, 450, and 600 for every method.
test: 1,024 fresh trajectories per seed; every seed and method frozen before generation; test namespace 2026102702.
smoke: Integration only after both gates pass: one source seed, four draws, eight test paths, independent test namespace 2026102704. Accuracy is ignored.
